domain_description: Well production analysis and optimization including decline curve analysis, nodal analysis, well testing interpretation, reservoir simulation, production optimization, sand control, scale and corrosion management, artificial lift optimization, and surface facility design. Based on SPE PRMS resource classification, API recommended practices, and established reservoir engineering methods.
authority_sources: API RP 14E (Recommended Practice for Design and Installation of Offshore Production Platform Piping Systems)
API RP 14C (Recommended Practice for Analysis, Design, Installation, and Testing of Safety Systems)
Arps Decline Curve Analysis (Exponential, Hyperbolic, Harmonic)
API RP 11AR (Recommended Practice for Artificial Lift)
NACE SP0775 (Preparation, Installation, Analysis, and Interpretation of Corrosion Coupons)

engines.name: Decline Curve Analysis Engine
engines.function: Perform Arps decline curve analysis including exponential, hyperbolic, and harmonic models, modified hyperbolic with terminal decline, stretched exponential, and Duong models for EUR estimation and production forecasting.
doctrine_topics: modified hyperbolic with terminal decline rate
Duong rate-decline analysis for tight reservoirs
decline curve analysis for horizontal multifrac wells

golden_queries.question: A Permian Basin Wolfcamp horizontal well has 24 months of production data: IP 1,200 BOPD, currently producing 250 BOPD. Fit the decline curve, determine b-factor, and estimate 30-year EUR with uncertainty bounds.
required_elements: Duong model comparison for tight rock

golden_queries.question: Compare Arps, stretched exponential, and Duong decline models for a Haynesville shale gas well with 36 months of production history showing b-factor drift
required_elements: model parameter fits for each method

engines.name: Nodal Analysis Engine
engines.function: Perform nodal analysis for production system optimization including inflow performance relationships, vertical lift performance, choke performance, and system sensitivity analysis using Vogel, Fetkovich, and multiphase flow correlations.
doctrine_topics: Vogel IPR for solution gas drive reservoirs
choke performance and critical flow analysis
artificial lift impact on system performance
system optimization and operating point selection

golden_queries.question: Perform a nodal analysis for a well with reservoir pressure of 3,200 psi, bubble point of 2,800 psi, PI above bubble of 2.5 STB/d/psi, 9,000 ft TVD, 3.5-inch tubing, producing 200 BOPD with 500 BWPD and GOR of 800 scf/STB
required_elements: water cut impact on lift performance
future performance prediction at lower reservoir pressure

engines.name: Well Testing Engine
engines.function: Analyze well test data including drawdown, buildup, falloff, and interference tests using pressure-transient analysis, derivative diagnostics, and type curve matching for reservoir characterization.
doctrine_topics: radial composite and dual porosity models
real-time well test design and monitoring

golden_queries.question: Interpret a 72-hour pressure buildup test showing a unit-slope line for 2 hours, followed by derivative stabilization at 50 psi, then a late-time derivative uptrend. The well is in a carbonate reservoir with known fractures.

engines.name: Reservoir Simulation Engine
engines.function: Analyze reservoir simulation models including black-oil, compositional, and dual-porosity formulations, history matching workflows, forecast scenarios, and uncertainty quantification for field development planning.
doctrine_topics: compositional simulation for volatile oil/gas condensate
relative permeability and capillary pressure models

golden_queries.question: Design a history matching workflow for a 500-well Spraberry field model with 20 years of production history, variable completion types, and water injection, showing systematic pressure mismatch in the eastern sector
required_elements: aquifer model or boundary condition assessment

engines.name: Production Optimization Engine
engines.function: Optimize well and field production through rate optimization, waterflood management, gas management, facility debottlenecking, and integrated asset modeling for maximum economic recovery.
doctrine_topics: integrated asset modeling reservoir to sales

golden_queries.question: A mature waterflood with 200 producers and 80 injectors shows declining oil rate with increasing WOR. Injection water is being recycled. Design a production optimization program to arrest the decline.

engines.name: Sand Control Engine
engines.function: Analyze sand production prediction, sand control method selection, gravel pack design, screen selection, chemical consolidation, and frac-pack completions for unconsolidated formations.
doctrine_topics: sand management vs sand exclusion strategies
particle size analysis and gravel sizing

golden_queries.question: Design a sand control strategy for a high-rate Gulf of Mexico deepwater well producing 15,000 BOPD from a poorly consolidated sandstone with D50 of 120 microns, UCS of 500 psi, and bottomhole flowing pressure drawdown of 2,000 psi
required_elements: gravel size selection using Saucier criteria

engines.name: Scale Treatment Engine
engines.function: Analyze scale formation prediction, inhibitor selection, squeeze treatment design, continuous injection optimization, and scale monitoring for calcium carbonate, barium sulfate, and other mineral scales.
doctrine_topics: barium sulfate scale risk in commingled production
produced water chemistry analysis for scaling
downhole and surface scale removal methods

golden_queries.question: A waterflood producer is commingling Wolfcamp and Bone Spring zones. Produced water analysis shows 250 ppm Ba2+ from one zone and 1,800 ppm SO4 from the injection water. Design a scale management program.

engines.name: Corrosion Management Engine
engines.function: Analyze production system corrosion mechanisms, inhibitor programs, material selection, cathodic protection, monitoring techniques, and integrity assessment per NACE standards for sweet and sour service.
doctrine_topics: H2S corrosion and sulfide stress cracking NACE MR0175
internal corrosion monitoring coupon and probe
erosion-corrosion in multiphase flow API RP 14E

golden_queries.question: Design a corrosion management program for a sour gas gathering system with 5% H2S, 8% CO2, produced water pH 4.5, chlorides of 120,000 ppm, and bottomhole temperature of 250F

engines.name: Artificial Lift Optimization Engine
engines.function: Optimize artificial lift system performance including rod pump dynamometer analysis, ESP surveillance, gas lift troubleshooting, plunger lift optimization, and lift method conversion evaluation.
doctrine_topics: plunger lift velocity and arrival analysis
rod string failure analysis and prevention

golden_queries.question: A rod pumped well shows a dynamometer card with fluid pound. The well has a pump setting depth of 8,500 ft, 1.75-inch plunger, 24 SPM, 100-inch stroke, and fluid level at 6,000 ft. Diagnose and recommend corrective action.
required_elements: fluid pound diagnosis from dynacard shape

engines.name: Facilities Design Engine
engines.function: Design and optimize surface production facilities including separation equipment, compression, dehydration, treating, measurement, and pipeline systems per API RP 14C safety analysis and design codes.
doctrine_topics: measurement systems LACT and gas metering
API RP 14C safety analysis and PSV sizing

golden_queries.question: Design a central gathering facility for a 100-well Permian Basin development producing 20,000 BOPD total, 60 MMSCFD gas, 40,000 BWPD, 500 psig wellhead pressure, with pipeline delivery requirements of 300 psi oil and 1,000 psi gas
